title: Expose orphan payload reconcile controls
summary: Exposes selected-row Pending Publish orphan-payload reconcile dry-run/apply controls through backend-owned Local API routes, with strict dry-run-first and fingerprint-gated apply behavior. Refreshes WebView command/route ownership reports plus DOM/global export inventories for the current rendered WebView surface.
reason: The repair/reconcile backlog still treated orphan-payload controls as open even though backend routes existed. Operators needed a bounded WebView path that sends only route intent while preserving backend mutation authority and keeping apply blocked without complete backend-derived pending_push_manifest.v1 evidence.
behavior_before: Pending Publish WebView exposed selected-row pending manifest repair controls, but orphan-payload reconcile remained backend-route-only and docs/inventories said no WebView caller existed.
behavior_after: Pending Publish WebView exposes selected-row orphan-payload reconcile dry-run and apply buttons. Dry-run posts only scope, row_key, limit, and reason. Apply remains disabled unless the matching backend dry-run returns safe_to_apply=true and a dry_run_fingerprint, then posts only the same selector fields plus dry_run_fingerprint and confirm_apply=true.
manual_validation: git diff --check - passed with line-ending warnings only
rollback_plan: Revert the Pending Publish orphan reconcile WebView controls and parent exports, restore generated WebView guard/inventory files from the previous commit, and leave backend orphan reconcile routes unchanged.
notes:
High-risk boundary: this change adds WebView route intent only. Backend remains the sole owner of pending manifest creation/write policy, dry-run evidence, fingerprint matching, strict confirm_apply enforcement, command journaling, and any filesystem mutation. Orphan-payload apply remains blocked unless backend evidence supplies a complete pending_push_manifest.v1 proposal. Representative source/payload/output hash validation and deferred publish/drain real-media validation were not run in this slice and remain required before treating orphan-payload reconcile as daily-driver safe.
Regenerated WebView DOM ID gap report after Pending Publish repair/reconcile DOM changes.
Refreshed summary for regenerated WebView DOM ID gap report.
